decisions: Q1 (accent default): accent_use defaults to "sparing" for EVERY kit, including kits saved before v2. No 'bold' backfill for old kits. This intentionally changes how today's documents look.

Q2 (hosted re-seed): no hosted re-seed job in this PRD. Render-level changes (roles, type scale, spacing, logo size) apply to every template at render time; new starters reach workspaces only through the existing starter-refresh rule (local: re-seeded at boot; hosted: at workspace creation).
Q3 (the designer's scope): the Brand designer (Wave 2) does the kit plus DOCUMENT templates (pdf, docx, xlsx) only, not social template layouts.
Q4 (onboarding): no onboarding change. The brand board is not an onboarding step.
Q5 (type default): ONE default professional type scale for every kit. No presets (no 'editorial' / 'compact').
project: PRD-255 Brand Kit v2 — Wave 1: the v2 kit, and every renderer reading it
description: Wave 1 of PRD-255 (docs/PRDS/PRD-255-BRAND-KIT-V2.md, seeded onto the branch by the runner). 'Accent not the background of a text-heavy card under sparing': a test over the composed CSS/HTML of the text-heavy families (quote, definition, fact, stats, data-story, carousel). media_render_bundle.py, brand_palette.py and templates/social/ are on the media-render and prod-images path gates: both lanes run and must be green. userStories.title: Agents and Auto see and change the whole kit
userStories.description: As an owner, I want to tell Auto "make the orange an accent only" or "more space between sections" and have it change my kit.
acceptanceCriteria: `platform_update_brand_kit` (`actions_brand_kit_update.py`) accepts every v2 field. Its schema equals `BrandKit`'s fields (the existing schema-parity test is extended).
`platform_get_brand_kit` returns the v2 kit, including derived roles marked `derived`.

The session agents' rules block (`services/brand_rules.py rules_for_kit`) carries the roles (not just the four colours), the type scale summary, the currency, the date style and the logo-variant file paths (F332 pattern).
Tests: the action round-trips every field; the rules block lists the roles.
CI green on HEAD: the required test.yml jobs pass on this story's commit (the run id is recorded in the DONE mark).

userStories.title: The Brand kit page shows and edits v2
userStories.description: As an owner, I want to see and change my roles, type scale, spacing and logo variants on the Brand kit page.
acceptanceCriteria: The Brand kit tab has sections: **Colours:** each role as a swatch with its hex and a contrast badge, and "derived" or "set" per role. **Type:** the scale with a live sample line per level. **Spacing and logo:** the unit, margins, letterhead logo size and clear space, with a preview. **Logo variants:** upload dark and mono. **Locale:** currency and date style. **Voice:** tone words with meanings.
"Reset to derived" per role.
Saving shows a contrast error inline (from US-001's 422).
vitest for the sections; typecheck passes.
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill. → OWNER: the owner's browser check (ownerTest in this file). The loop never runs a browser, never marks this AC DONE, and never claims it.
CI green on HEAD: the required test.yml jobs pass on this story's commit (the run id is recorded in the DONE mark).
userStories.notes: Anchors (frontend, on main): frontend/components/deliverables/brand/brand-kit-tab.tsx (45 lines: the tab), brand-kit-basics.tsx, brand-kit-fields.tsx, brand-kit-images.tsx (the logo and logo-mark uploads: add the dark and mono variants the same way), brand-kit-preview.tsx, use-brand-kit-form.ts (139 lines), brand-voice-examples.tsx, __tests__/brand-kit-tab.test.tsx; frontend/components/documents/blocks/api.ts (BRAND_LOGO_PATH, BRAND_LOGO_MARK_PATH) and types.ts (the BrandKit type); frontend/lib/api-client.ts (brand-kit calls). New sections are new small components (brand-kit-colours.tsx, brand-kit-type.tsx, brand-kit-spacing.tsx, brand-kit-locale.tsx, ...): a React component ≤ 150 lines. 'Reset to derived' removes the role from the stored palette (PUT palette with that role null/absent — match US-001's patch semantics) and re-reads GET. The contrast badge reads the ratio against the effective paper (compute it client-side from the hexes, the WCAG formula as a small pure util with its own vitest). The 422 from US-001 (loc ['palette','<role>']) shows under that role's swatch. All calls through apiClient (raw fetch is an ESLint error). Compact (phone) CSS only in the compact region of frontend/app/globals.css. vitest: frontend/components/deliverables/brand/__tests__/brand-kit-*.test.tsx (one per new section at least). Typecheck = the Frontend CI job's baselined tsc: no new errors (diff tsc's error list, not the count).
